what: First map built from scratch: Crucible, written by tools/make_map.py as a native 2.9.2 .TRN and loaded by the real client; later the same day a Far Yards section 405 km out with a navigation waypoint

offline_checks.tests: tools/test_make_map.py: 12 passed (record layout against JRMAP's editor records, yaw convention against JRMAP flag3, proper rotations, zones, waypoint record -> navigation_buoys.trn_placements -> LoadObject kind 3 slot 90, --map-waypoints option checks, rejections, spec round trip, objects present in the user's AOAOBJECTS.ODB); test_station_runtime, test_powerups and test_navigation_buoys unchanged and passing
offline_checks.preview: make_map.py obj + render_obj.py from the original meshes and textures: 80/89 records drawn (zones and the waypoint are not drawn); spawn 3,293 units clear of the nearest bounding sphere

live.client: separate play copy work/custom-map/client of game/2.9.2 (patch_version 21 in _client_setup.json; AOACLIENT.EXE sha256 c56d9b8d5b74d626e4e5829101b1bd863bfa3be8eebceac350ac91791e057e3a); the map installed in its jrmap292.trn slot
live.server: station_stub.py --profile local-relay --map JRMAP --experimental-terrain --spawn-at ... --powerup-zones <copy>/jrmap292.trn (and, for the waypoint runs, --map-waypoints <copy>/jrmap292.trn --sustained-delivery), loopback
live.method: window-message login and Station Play (tools/reel/record.py flow), terrain and world-object lists read from memory by inspect_arena.snapshot, T sent with window.key, F5 captures

runs.result: all 62 named models present at their spec positions (no coordinate off by more than 2 units); the 2 safe zones listed under the default name '---'; HUD showed 'Entering Safe Zone' and the blue zone tint at the spawn
screenshot shows the DishWall gate, hy_base and the MBB/MCVA guards drawn with textures

host printed 'JRMAP navigation buoys: 1' and 'power-ups: 6'; world object slot 90 'Far Yards', tag 0x4001005a, kind 3, visible, at (220915, 67235, 307123); six power-up objects (slots 100-105) at points inside their zones. After T the three target windows showed 'Far Yards' / 'NavMark.' with relation N and the on-screen marker read about 389k (actual distance 389,100 units)
screenshot shows the slipway walls with the ZDD inside, tugs, dock and anchor rock; after T the target windows showed Far Yards at 1.7k
